run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

judge_context.description: Protocol for what the judge was shown about each arm's treatment material. treatment_material.v1 when every score saw the stored material; treatment_material.v1+snippet_fallback when only some did (pools with nothing). Absent when every score used the 200-char report snippets — the protocol of runs judged before the stamp existed.

judge_context_sources.description: Judged scores counted by judge_context_source (stored / snippet_fallback).

judge_materials.description: One copy of each distinct text the judge was shown as an arm's treatment material, keyed by its sha256:<hex> digest. Each answers[].arms.<arm>.judge_context_sha256 (and each stored score's judge_context_sha256) names the one it saw, so a later judge can be shown the same evidence.

errors.description: Cells that errored (the answer call failed or the judge raised). Left out of n and avg_aggregate.

significance.description: Paired test of this arm against the shared baseline arm. Absent on the baseline arm itself, and on arms with too few complete pairs to describe.

n.description: Complete pairs contributing (questions scored in both this arm and the baseline).

cohens_d.description: Cohen's d_z on the paired deltas (sample SD, ddof=1). Null when the deltas are constant and non-zero, where d_z is unbounded rather than zero; 0.0 when every delta is zero.

p.description: Two-sided sign-flip p of the per-question deltas (each sign a fair coin under the null), over the pairs whose delta is not within 1e-9 of 0: exact up to 16 of them, Monte Carlo (20 000 draws, fixed seed) above. Uncorrected. Null when every one is within 1e-9 of 0: there is no evidence either way.

n_changed.description: Pairs whose delta is not within 1e-9 of 0, the ones p is computed over. The smallest p is 2 / 2^n_changed (exact), so at 5 or fewer no p can go below 0.05 and significant is null.

p_ttest.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the two-sided paired t-test p.

p_wilcoxon.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p (zero_method=zsplit).

n_wilcoxon.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the pairs the signed-rank test used.

ci_method.description: How ci_lo/ci_hi were computed. sign_flip_inversion: every shift the sign-flip test behind p does not reject at 0.05, uncorrected, so the interval excludes 0 exactly when p < 0.05; an end is null where it is open, as both are at 5 or fewer pairs. student_t (coherent with p_ttest), percentile_bootstrap and degenerate are what records written before the sign-flip test hold.

significant.description: Unadjusted verdict, p < 0.05. Null when there is no verdict, which is not the same as a negative one: no p, or 2 / 2^n_changed is not below 0.05 (in a record written before the sign-flip test: no test could run).

p_adjusted.description: p corrected across the treatment arms in this run (in a record written before the sign-flip test: p_ttest corrected).

significant_adjusted.description: Verdict at alpha = 0.05 using p_adjusted. Null wherever significant is null.

correction_family.description: Which set of hypotheses this p was corrected within. Arm comparisons and interaction contrasts are separate families.

family_size.description: Treatment arms in the comparison family.

family_tested.description: Treatment arms with a p, the effective correction multiplier; one whose significant is null because of 2 / 2^n_changed still counts.

interactions.description: One entry per detected 2x2 factorial cell, i.e. per combined arm whose two sub-treatments are also present as standalone arms. Absent when no such cell exists.

n.description: Questions scored in all four cells.

additive_expectation.description: delta_a + delta_b, i.e. the combined delta implied by no interaction.

interaction.description: Per-question contrast combined - A - B + baseline. Negative means the treatments interfere; positive means they reinforce.

delta_mean.description: Same value as interaction, kept so the block reads like any other delta description.

cohens_d.description: Cohen's d_z on the interaction contrasts (sample SD, ddof=1). Null when the contrast is constant and non-zero; 0.0 when every contrast is zero.

p.description: Two-sided sign-flip p of the per-question contrasts (each sign a fair coin under the null), over the questions whose contrast is not within 1e-9 of 0: exact up to 16 of them, Monte Carlo (20 000 draws, fixed seed) above. Uncorrected. Null when every one is within 1e-9 of 0: there is no evidence either way.

n_changed.description: Questions whose contrast is not within 1e-9 of 0, the ones p is computed over. The smallest p is 2 / 2^n_changed (exact), so at 5 or fewer no p can go below 0.05 and significant is null.

ci_method.description: How ci_lo/ci_hi were computed. sign_flip_inversion: every shift the sign-flip test behind p does not reject at 0.05, uncorrected, so the interval excludes 0 exactly when p < 0.05; an end is null where it is open, as both are at 5 or fewer pairs. student_t (coherent with p_ttest), percentile_bootstrap and degenerate are what records written before the sign-flip test hold.

p_ttest.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the two-sided paired t-test p.

p_wilcoxon.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p (zero_method=zsplit).

n_wilcoxon.description: Held by records written before the sign-flip test (issue #421); a new record does not write it: the pairs the signed-rank test used.

significant.description: Unadjusted verdict, p < 0.05. Null when there is no verdict, which is not the same as a negative one: no p, or 2 / 2^n_changed is not below 0.05 (in a record written before the sign-flip test: no test could run).

p_adjusted.description: p corrected across the interaction contrasts in this run — their own family, not pooled with the per-arm comparisons (in a record written before the sign-flip test: p_ttest corrected).

significant_adjusted.description: Verdict at alpha = 0.05 using p_adjusted. Null wherever significant is null.

family_tested.description: Interaction contrasts with a p, the effective correction multiplier; one whose significant is null because of 2 / 2^n_changed still counts.
